confidence_notes: I ran two web searches: one for the RBA rate and one for Pisa prices. The Pisa search returned Numbeo-based cost-of-living aggregates, and I converted euros to USD at roughly 1.16 USD per EUR. Beer, coffee, inexpensive meal and mid-range meal anchors rest on those aggregates. Cocktail and wine were not searched directly. I set them from typical Italian price relationships to beer (cocktail about 1.7x, wine glass about 0.9x). Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not checked against listings. July is peak season, and Pisa hostel supply is limited, so those anchors are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Pisa aggregates from Numbeo-derived sources, with other Tuscan university and tourist cities such as Florence and Siena as the comparison for accommodation. Pisa's accommodation is somewhat cheaper than Florence's.
